PZZ700-130815-
1238 PM PDT Mon Oct 12 2026

.Synopsis for the far Southern CA coast...
At 12 PM, a 1024 mb high was around 600 nautical miles west of 
Cape Mendocino and a 1004 mb low over the Sierra Nevadas. Weak offshore
flow expected near shore Tuesday morning. Offshore flow during 
nights and mornings will alternate with northwest onshore flow 
during afternoons and evenings through Wednesday. Offshore flow 
will begin to dominate and strengthen Thursday through Saturday. 

$$
